g.text: A PERSONAL INTERRUPTION
1 +165.947: locally visible entrance guard is recognized. No
remote identity knowledge.
2–5: chosen object hits and permitted retreats. Fear and
protective retreat keep Bone interested.
6 +213.947: one deliberate, precise final hit. The guard is
not killed by an accidental near-miss.
Turquoise: guard movement from ordinary duty into the local
emergency, then retreat. Blue: Bone’s separate bursts.
Dialogue opportunities only: fractured recognition, confused
child/Witch identity, scraps of the arrest memory. No
finished lines or further family history.
Other guards receive no inherited guilt. Both survive this
branch.
